name: mirror-displays
title: Mirror Displays
description: Toggles mirroring of external displays quickly
author: yonbergman

commands.name: mirror-displays
commands.title: Mirror Displays
commands.description: Choose which display to mirror, or turn off mirroring.

commands.name: toggle-mirroring
commands.title: Toggle Mirroring
commands.description: Turn display mirroring off if it's on, or on (using your default direction) if it's off. Bind this to a hotkey for instant toggling.

preferences.name: defaultToggleDirection
preferences.title: Default Toggle Direction
preferences.description: Which direction to mirror when Toggle Mirroring turns mirroring on.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
